A shipping coordinator needs to load packages onto identical delivery trucks. The packages are as follows:

* Package 26: weight 64kg
* Package 27: weight 37kg
* Package 28: weight 50kg

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 kg. Load all packages using the fewest number of trucks. Every package must be placed on exactly one truck, and the total weight loaded onto any truck cannot exceed its capacity.
